Abrechnungsposition.description: One position of a stored settlement receipt.

legal_basis.description: The provision the position rests on.

pflichtzahlung_eur.description: A separate § 52 EEG 2023 Pflichtzahlung owed to the Netzbetreiber.

on.description: Date to evaluate, ISO 8601 (`YYYY-MM-DD`). Defaults to today.

billing_month.description: The month, for a Monatsmarktwert. Omitted for a Jahresmarktwert.

foerderendedatum.description:
The EEG Förderende, or `NULL` for a plant that has none.

§ 25 Abs. 1 EEG 2023 dates the EEG claim in years. § 8 KWKG does not: it
measures the Zuschlag in Vollbenutzungsstunden (Abs. 1–3) and caps each
calendar year separately (Abs. 4), and both are counters against
generation. A KWK plant therefore has no calendar Förderende and this is
`NULL` for it — `kwk_max_kwh` is what ends its Zuschlag.

kwk_bmwk_feststellung.description: § 7 Abs. 1 Satz 2 KWKG — whether the BMWK Feststellung is published.

kwk_bimschg_genehmigung.description: § 6 Abs. 1 Satz 1 Nr. 1 lit. c aa KWKG — BImSchG-Genehmigung erteilt am.

kwk_verbindliche_bestellung.description: § 6 Abs. 1 Satz 1 Nr. 1 lit. c bb KWKG — verbindliche Bestellung am.

wind_guetefaktor_reevaluations.description:

sect9_begrenzung_60.description: § 9 Abs. 2 Satz 1 Nr. 2 lit. b / Nr. 3 — 60 % Wirkleistungsbegrenzung.

wechselrichterleistung_va.description: Wechselrichterleistung in VA, for the Abs. 2 Satz 4 Steckersolar carve-out.

gebotstermin.description: The Gebotstermin of the Zuschlag (§ 100 Abs. 37 EEG 2023).

Nr. 2 Satz 3 moves a plant claiming either option onto the
Jahresmarktwert whatever its vintage.

avg_ct_kwh.description:
The energieträgerspezifische Marktwert in ct/kWh, published by the ÜNB at
netztransparenz.de.

vorlaeufig.description:
An ÜNB running estimate rather than the binding figure. Only a
Jahresmarktwert can be one; it is ignored for a Monatsmarktwert.

§ 52 Abs. 2 EEG 2023: 10 €/kW per month; `None` for a plant under the

year.description: Abrechnungsjahr to filter on, e.g. 2026. Omit for every year.

month.description: Abrechnungsmonat to filter on, 1-12. Omit for every month.

SettlementReceipt.description:
One settlement receipt as the history lists it: an original and the
correction that superseded it are two rows for one month, told apart by
`is_correction` / `correction_of` — without them the history reads as a
double payment.

status.description:
`calculated`, `price_missing`, `no_data`, `error`, `foerderung_beendet`,
`jahreskontingent_erschoepft`, `sanctioned`, `kein_anspruch`, `unknown`
or `gehalten` — a stable code, worded by the reader's catalogue.

error_detail.description:
Why a settlement that paid nothing did not — the developer text beside
`status`.

faelligkeitsdatum.description: § 26 Abs. 1 EEG 2023: the payment's due date.

saturated.description: At least `limit` receipts matched: older ones were not listed.

inbetriebnahme.description:
Inbetriebnahme date (`YYYY-MM-DD`) — **required for solar**. The §49
degression steps on 1 February and 1 August, so a year alone does not
determine a solar rate.

messkonzept.description: VOLLEINSPEISUNG or UEBERSCHUSSEINSPEISUNG (solar only; default: UEBERSCHUSS).

verguetungsform.description:
UEBERSCHUSS (default) | VOLLEINSPEISUNG (§48 Abs. 2a bonus) | KWK_ZUSCHLAG.
The two solar forms differ by several ct/kWh.

einspeisemenge_kwh.description: Override kWh. When absent, fetched from edmd.

epex_avg_ct_kwh.description:
